Starts after the September 25, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the October 16, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.

notes.title: A wild frenzy of switches and counters! Chain Skills are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/78f069284692ad69aba22d09ecfdabdd58947f67.png[/img]
[h1]Chain Skills have been added to the game![/h1]

[h2]What Are Chain Skills?[/h2]
When using a Chain Skill by switching, you will temporarily enter a Chain state.
While in a Chain state, you can use all of your skills, not just the one in your first Skill Slot, as switches.
* However, non-Chain Skill skills must be Limit Break +10 to be used as switches while in a Chain state.

Using a Chain Skill while in a Chain state will also provide special effects to skills used as switches while in a Chain state.
Using multiple Chain Skills can cause their special effects to overlap, allowing you to unleash powerful attacks.

Also, special additional damage will be applied beyond the regular chain effects depending on the number of times you switch while in a Chain state.
This is known as a Super Chain.

To see these special effects, go to a skill's details screen and check the tab marked with the blue "CS" icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/7686f7ea71eb5dfa8f50930d774329c3a8d483a0.png[/img]
While in a Chain state, special effects will apply to other skills that are Limit Break +10, such as Connect Skills, Accele Skills, and Full Burst Skills.
For example, using Connect Skills while in a Chain state will give each skill the Chain state's effects so long as the linked skills are Limit Break +10.
Also, the Chain Skill's special effects will be applied to those linked skills if a Chain Skill is a linked skill.
Full Burst Skills act similarly, with the Chain state's effects applying to Full Burst or Burst Skills while the Full Burst state is also active.
This can result in powerful effects depending on how you combine them, so try it out in battle!

[h2]Activating a Chain State[/h2]
There are two ways to activate a Chain state by using a Chain Skill.
1: Use a Chain Skill placed in your first Skill Slot during a switch.
2: Use a Chain Skill at the right moment during certain attacks. (Detailed later under "Counter Switch")

The remaining effect time will be displayed on the Switch Gauge when in a Chain state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/300fc7fee7b5aacfb6dec8ad1108cd302f1cbc81.png[/img]

You can also extend a Chain state's activation time depending on the amount of Switch Gauge you have.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Switch Gauge Amount[/th]
        [th]Activation Time[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr][td]1[/td][td]30 sec.[/td][/tr]
    [tr][td]2[/td][td]45 sec.[/td][/tr]
    [tr][td]3[/td][td]60 sec.[/td][/tr]
[/table]
There will be a set amount of cooldown time after a Chain state ends.
You cannot enter a Chain state by using a Chain Skill during this cooldown time.
You can check on this cooldown time by referencing the color of the Switch Gauge's border.
When the border's gray area is entirely gone and the "CS" area is lit, the cooldown time has ended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/d8505e960b4935d758ca558f577273c69e2d4c63.png[/img]

[h2]Chain Skill Abilities[/h2]
Equipping these allow you to raise the maximum damage of your Super Chains and increase the activation time of your Chain states.
Please note that equipping something to an EX Ability slot will not provide any of these effects.

[h2]Counter Switch[/h2]
Use a Chain Skill at the right moment during specific attacks to both nullify that attack's damage and deal damage to your opponent with that Chain Skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/dbbb47cbb295c744683c3f92a21387d3dd2e444f.png[/img]

If you meet the conditions to enter a Chain state as this happens, you will then enter one.
A debuff will be applied to the enemy for a period of time, allowing you to deal increased damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/732c7d52dc8e275bbce85f0e98ebf684483324fb.png[/img]
Attacks that can be Counter Switched have different visual effects from regular attacks.
The color of the visual effect displayed on the ground will be a deep orange that switches to blue.
In order to successfully Counter Switch, you will need to land a Chain Skill during the moment that this effect is blue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/4aae332ab15beffd826714becc4bed46d32aa15e.png[/img]
Not all enemies have these kinds of attacks.
Also, you cannot enter a Chain state by using a Chain Skill during its cooldown time even if you activate a Counter Switch.

[h2]Monster with a Counter Switch Targeted Attacks[/h2]
With the introduction of Counter Switch, not only newly added monsters but also the following existing monsters will now use Counter Switch Targeted Attacks.
[list]
[*] Floor bosses and dungeon bosses of each floor
[*] Each boss of the Chaos Showdown
[/list]
* "Teo the Teaser Tentacles", "The Last Number" and "Last Number Chaos" are not included.

Additional Counter Switch Targeted Attacks may be added to existing monsters in the future.

[h2]Exiting the Chain state[/h2]
The Chain state is primarily exited in the following ways.
[list]
[*] The remaining time in the Chain state runs out.
[*] The area changes.
[*] A Quick Change is performed.
[*] The Menu Screen is displayed.
[*] Your character is defeated.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/4b3aee4e3525a6ffc88362818d8922808eefd6f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/3c3533493586bcd9c5055ec971c22b450c4f5c53.png[/img]

[*] Relaxed requirements on Integral Series production and transformation, as well as Chaos Showdown.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44123491/c2b74e91c633538e176662c36f702c2c75bed702.png[/img]
[h2]Full Burst Skill added![/h2]

[h3]What is a Full Burst Skill?[/h3]
These are skills where you enter the Full Burst state for a period of time after unleashing an attack and become temporarily invulnerable, like a Burst Skill.
By entering the Full Burst state, you can immediately use a Full Burst Skill or a Burst Skill (Limit Break +10) regardless of activation requirements.
You can also use it an additional number of times by equipping Full Burst Skill Ability equipment pieces.

The following are Full Burst-Associated Skills that acquire additional effects and can be used while in the Full Burst state.
Full Burst-Associated Skills are Full Burst Skills and Limit Break +10 Burst Skills.

[h3]Activating a Full Burst Skill[/h3]
Like Burst Skills, using Skill Records in a specific order will fulfill the Burst activation requirements.
You will enter the Full Burst state after the skill's Burst activates.
Fulfilling the activation requirements will cause the skill icon to glow magenta.

[h3]Using skills while in the Full Burst state[/h3]
An equipped Full Burst-Associated Skill can be used once immediately regardless of activation requirements. (SP will not be consumed.)
Additional Full Burst-Associated Skills can then be used according to the number of Full Burst Ability pieces equipped.
The same Skill Record cannot be used more than once during these additional Full Burst Ability equipment usages.
After the Full Burst state ends, there will be 120 seconds of cooldown time until the Full Burst state can be activated again by fulfilling the activation requirements.
* Full Burst Skills can be used during this cooldown time, but the Full Burst state will not be entered.
You can check how much time is left in the Full Burst state and the cooldown period using the Time Limit Gauge at the bottom of the screen.

[h3]Limit Breaking Full Burst Skills[/h3]
Limit Breaking a Full Burst Skill to +10 will remove the final activation requirement.
Example:
Regular Full Burst Skill: Fire → Fire → Slash → Wind
Limit Break +10 Full Burst Skill: Fire → Fire → Slash

[h3]Full Burst Ability[/h3]
Full Burst Skill abilities are known as Full Burst Abilities.
By equipping these abilities to an ability slot, you can increase the number of Full Burst-Associated Skill usages while in the Full Burst state by one time per piece.
Effects while in the Full Burst state change depending on the Burst type.
* Stock: Using a Full Burst-Associated Skill resets the time remaining, and the Full Burst state time is extended with each additional piece of equipment.
* Chain: The damage multiplier of Full Burst-Associated Skills used while in the Full Burst state increases with each additional piece of equipment.

The maximum number of uses while in this additional Full Burst state is equal to the number of Sword Skill or Ability Full Burst / Limit Break +10 Burst Skill Records equipped within the same set, whichever is fewer.
Example:
4 Sword Skills equipped, 4 Abilities equipped: 4 activations possible
3 Sword Skills equipped, 4 Abilities equipped: 3 activations possible
3 Sword Skills equipped, 2 Abilities equipped: 2 activations possible

The Burst type and the number of additional usages while in the Full Burst state will be displayed on the Time Limit Gauge at the bottom of the screen.
Please note that equipping something to an EX Ability slot will not provide any effects relating to Full Burst.

[h3]Exiting the Full Burst state[/h3]
The Full Burst state is primarily exited in the following ways.
* The remaining time in the Full Burst state runs out.
* All Full Burst-Associated Skill uses are exhausted.
* The area changes.
* A Quick Change is performed.
* The Menu Screen is displayed.
* Your character is defeated.

[h3]Important[/h3]
If a Full Burst Skill is used during a Switch, it will have its regular skill effect.
Only regular Bursts will activate during the cooldown time following the end of the Full Burst state.
Skill Records aside from Full Burst-Associated Skills can still be used even when in the Full Burst state.

notes.title: Features and Notes on the Steam version
notes.content:
[b]■Support for Gamepad or Keyboard & Mouse[/b]

The Steam version of the game can be operated by gamepad or keyboard & mouse.

Screens that focus on gameplay, such as field movement and battles, can be controlled by gamepad.

For screens that cannot be used with the gamepad, such as controls after expanding the menu, please use the keyboard & mouse or use "Mouse Mode".

There are two types of Camera/Cursor Control: type A and type B.
This can be set in Settings > Detail > Controls > Camera/Cursor Control.

Type A
- Camera Controls: Mouse
- Cursor Controls: Left alt key (default) + mouse

Type B
- Camera Controls: Mouse drag
- Cursor Controls: Mouse

Please check the guide at the top of the screen for the corresponding buttons and keys.
All of these settings can be changed under Key Configuration.

▼Key Configuration
When operating with a gamepad, "Skill & Item Mode" and "Mouse Mode" are controls that must always be done while pressing different buttons.
Please note that it is not possible to assign these to a single button.

▼Fishing Function
If the control guide is on while fishing and during its settings, the relevant keys will be displayed.
Each action can be performed by pressing the corresponding key, or by using the mouse's cursor to click the icon.

▼Switching to Gampad
When switching the gamepad during gameplay, the key guide may not be switched immediately.

[b]■Transferring Character from Other Platforms[/b]

We support cross-play, which allows players from all platforms (Steam, Android, Google Play Games, and iOS) to play with each other. To use your current account on another platform, however, you will need to transfer your account.
Before transferring your account, please read the transfer procedure and precautions on the FAQ site below.
[url=https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/faq/detail/3045/4238] https://bnfaq.channel.or.jp/faq/detail/3045/4238 [/url]

▼Arcana Gems
Arcana Gems will be lost when you transfer your character to a different platform's version, so please use all of your Arcana Gems before transferring.

▼Boost Mode
The effect is only activated on the platform version you subscribe with.
If you subscribe on the Steam version and transfer your character to a different platform, the effect will not be applied.
If you subscribe on another platform version and transfer your character to the Steam version, the effect will not be applied.

[b]■Other Notes[/b]

▼FPS
The Steam version supports up to 60FPS max.

▼VR Mode
The Steam version does not support VR mode.

▼Screenshot Function
You can choose to display or hide the UI when taking screenshots.
You can set this in Settings > Detail > Functions > Hide UI when taking screenshots.

▼For Those Using CPUs/GPUs by AMD
We have confirmed cases of reduced performance on some CPUs/GPUs made by AMD.
Please note that it may take some time for us to handle this issue, or we may not be able to handle the issue.
